text: The QuakeCoRE 2025 Annual Meeting (QCAM25) is a flagship event organized by Te Hiranga Rū QuakeCoRE, Aotearoa New Zealand’s Centre of Research Excellence, focused on transforming earthquake resilience through integrated research and collaboration. Held in Dunedin, the meeting brought together researchers, practitioners, policymakers, and international partners to accelerate the translation of earthquake science into societal impact. The event featured plenaries, poster sessions, workshops, and networking activities, emphasizing a system-level approach to earthquake resilience.
